original_test_intent: Stress BMC DRAM from U-Boot with `dramtest 0` for more than 12 hours at 40C/+5% rails, then prove normal BMC service.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Boot BMC to U-Boot, run `dramtest 0` for over 12 hours, collect results and logs.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY and required command semantics, but treated 7200-minute Machine Time as a formal conflict with >12 hours.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator establishes the margin condition and recovery console; command execution can be monitored after its vendor semantics are verified.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 40C/+5% rails and `dramtest 0` for more than 12 hours; 7200-minute Machine Time is a schedule estimate.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: BMC/U-Boot version, vendor command definition, approved duration/stop behavior, recovery path and acceptance.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Any approved duration change is explicit and does not rewrite the source.

original_method: The exact U-Boot command is preserved and is not guessed or substituted.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the platform vendor's documented BMC memory diagnostic for the exact firmware; retain `dramtest 0` if it is the supported command.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC silicon and U-Boot build.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Must be confirmed from vendor documentation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable vendor BMC/U-Boot diagnostic manual or approved SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: No change unless the vendor deprecates the command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must exercise the intended BMC DRAM and post-stress services.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Command semantics, error reporting and stop/recovery behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unknown U-Boot commands can hang the controller or obscure memory errors.

missing_inputs: BMC recovery and technical health criteria
safety_boundaries: Do not execute an undocumented bootloader command
Stop on loss of control or fixture limits
expected_evidence: Elapsed diagnostic output and memory errors
no_automatic_retry: No diagnostic restart after an error or BMC hang.
engineer_owned_verdict: BMC/margin engineer owns the formal result.
review_improvement: Separates planning time from the source duration while preserving the real semantic gate around a private bootloader diagnostic.
